title: Soluner's Sever Utilitys
description: A basic unchangeable server utils mod
body:
# Soluner's Server Utility Datapack
This is a datapack I created for a group of friends on a Minecraft server, and I thought I might as well share it here for everyone else to check out. I’m not sure if it’s good or not but hey, it’s here :/

## Features
### RTP
This datapack includes an RTP (Random Teleport) trigger.
You can activate it by using /trigger RTP.

It has a 40-second cooldown, so you can’t spam it to lag out the server.

⚠️ IF YOUR SERVER DOESN’T RUN WELL, PLEASE REMOVE THIS FEATURE ⚠️

This command causes lag as it renders new chunks. If your server can’t handle that,
use the command
**/scoreboard objectives remove RTP**

### Random Reward System
The second feature of this datapack is a random reward system for either all players or a single player. There are currently 12 possible rewards.

Some of these rewards include emeralds, diamonds, a lava bucket, and XP levels.
If you don’t want this feature and only want the RTP, I’ll release a version without rewards soon (or eventually, Im not sure yet).

The reward interval isn’t customizable, but it’s randomly timed between 28–40 minutes.

Each reward has a 1 in 12 chance of appearing. Two of the rewards are given to a random player—see if you can find them!

### Multiple New Recipes
This datapack adds 6 new recipes as quality-of-life features.
Most of them involve rails and powered rails, but there are a few outliers as well.

If you’re curious about the new recipes, check out the **Gallery** section of the datapack.
